'''Vindis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]], who was the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Darth Tormen]]. She eventually became a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] by the time of the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Death_of_Lord_Vindis.jpg|thumb|left|Lord Vindis is sacrificed to Zildrog.]]
Lord Vindis appears during "The Nathema Conspiracy" flashpoint only if [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] is a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]] who made the Light Side choice to kill Darth Tormen towards the end of their class story. In this case, Vindis will seek to destroy the one who killed her master to earn the title of [[Darth]] and join the [[Order of Zildrog]] led by [[Vinn Atrius]], only to be sacrificed as fuel to awaken [[Zildrog]] by [[GEMINI 16]] on [[Nathema]]. If the player makes a Dark Side choice to kill Supreme Chancellor [[Dorian Janarus]], his wife [[Malea Janarus|Malea]] will appear instead of Vindis, while the other classes face antagonists from their own class stories.<ref name="Nathema" />
